mechanism: Positive extreme funding identifies expensive levered long demand; simultaneous positive, cross-sectionally high open-interest growth and taker-buy dominance identify balance-sheet crowding vulnerable to deleveraging. A short perpetual supplies the opposite side and may earn both price unwind and funding.
hypothesis: The preregistered crowding state predicts positive net one-funding-interval short-perpetual return and adds positive incremental value beyond extreme positive funding alone.
null: Crowding has no positive net short return or no incremental value beyond funding alone, or fails temporal/cross-asset replication.

feature_contract.availability: Every metric uses the latest native create_time strictly earlier than funding time t; backward as-of only.
feature_contract.cross_section: At each common funding time with at least 8 valid assets, percentile ranks use only contemporaneously available assets.
feature_contract.crowding: funding(t)>0, funding percentile rank >=0.75, OI growth>0, OI-growth percentile rank>=0.75, and taker ratio>1
feature_contract.funding_only_baseline: funding(t)>0 and funding percentile rank>=0.75 but not crowding

outcome.entry: short perpetual at first 5m candle open strictly after t
outcome.exit: first 5m candle open strictly after the next official funding event
outcome.position: one fully collateralized unit, no leverage

statistics.bootstrap: 10000 UTC event-week cluster resamples, all assets retained per week
statistics.holm: asset, temporal and negative-control families separately at 0.05

controls.rule: OI growth state shifted forward exactly 30 UTC days within asset
OI growth state from next alphabetical asset at same funding time

gates: crowding net mean and lower CI are positive with p<0.05
incremental crowding-minus-funding-only mean and lower CI are positive with p<0.05
at least 8 assets have positive crowding means and at least 5 are Holm significant
all 3 temporal blocks are positive and at least 2 Holm significant
neither shifted nor cyclic OI control has positive significant incremental value

final.CONFIRMED_READY_FOR_PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMA: D2 and D3 pass every gate
final.INCONCLUSIVE: Integrity failure or contradictory result prevents valid decision
